g.text: LD2410C: regulated 5 V; logic is 3.3 V. J3 numbering follows the module drawing.

g.desc: LD2410C: regulated 5 V; logic is 3.3 V. J3 numbering follows the module drawing.

g.text: This is NOT the pin order of a generic JST cable. Verify assembled socket orientation.

g.desc: This is NOT the pin order of a generic JST cable. Verify assembled socket orientation.

g.text: U10 opens all three signal paths when GPIO11 is low; no pull-ups on the unpowered radar side.

g.desc: U10 opens all three signal paths when GPIO11 is low; no pull-ups on the unpowered radar side.

g.text: ON: rail PG valid before closing U10; ignore startup frames until qualified.

g.desc: ON: rail PG valid before closing U10; ignore startup frames until qualified.

g.text: OFF: open U10 before disabling 5 V. Check reset, brownout and sleep-hold behavior on the bench.

g.desc: OFF: open U10 before disabling 5 V. Check reset, brownout and sleep-hold behavior on the bench.

g.text: Powered-radar wake mode: retain 5 V and U10 ON, use OUT only as a wake hint, then verify UART.

g.desc: Powered-radar wake mode: retain 5 V and U10 ON, use OUT only as a wake hint, then verify UART.

g.text: U10 is signal isolation, not a voltage translator. The fourth channel is grounded and disabled.

g.desc: U10 is signal isolation, not a voltage translator. The fourth channel is grounded and disabled.
